Overview

Chefchaouen is a city in Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceïma with a population of 42,000. The famous Blue Pearl of Morocco, a stunning mountain town with blue-washed buildings and a relaxed atmosphere. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
